roadmap.title: Learn Exiles and early classes
roadmap.description: Buy upgrades, level Apprentice, and try early classes and pets. Build Mysteries through Exiles and open Attributes, Challenges and Trials.

roadmap.title: Build the collection and Tier 2 pets
roadmap.description: Open crafting at 1e80 Mysteries. Collect dust and develop the level-100 pets needed for their advanced forms.

roadmap.title: Add enchanting and finish Tier 1 unlocks
roadmap.description: Open enchanting at 1e200 Mysteries and weapons at 1e260. Unlock Alchemist, Ironsoul and Abolisher while improving equipment.

roadmap.title: Unlock Tier 2 classes and change Realm
roadmap.description: At 1e300 Mysteries, try the six Tier 2 classes. Finish the Challenge checklist, keep Expeditions running, and make your first Realm change after 1e400 Mysteries.

roadmap.title: Open the Pantheon and Tier 3 pets
roadmap.description: Reach 1e500 Mysteries for the Pantheon, then 1e550 for Tier 3 pets. Build their specific counters and open Void Memetics at 1e650.

roadmap.title: Level Gods and open late systems
roadmap.description: Pray to each major God until level 35. Open Catalyst Memetics at 1e750, Mana Source Memetics at 1e850, minor Gods at 1e1000, and Ascension Forms at 1e1100 Mysteries.

roadmap.title: Finish Legacy 100
roadmap.description: Continue the ordered Legacy tasks, including Trials, item quality, Gods, dust and Catalyst collection. Use the Journal to track the next unfinished requirement.

guide.context: Complete each of the 100 Challenges once. Entries are grouped by class; The Legion is split into its 13 phases. Start Challenges from Journal (V) when their entry requirements are met. A failed attempt can be restarted; completed seals survive Realm changes.

collectibles.name: Like the first time
collectibles.method: Use Patience, buy sources and upgrades, and cast Magic Missile while collecting Void Entities. Earn 1e12 mana as Apprentice.

collectibles.name: Like the first time II
collectibles.method: Build sources and upgrades with Patience, Magic Missile and captured Void Entities. Reach 1e16 mana; The Nexus is unavailable.

collectibles.name: Like the first time III
collectibles.method: Use Patience and Magic Missile to fund source purchases and upgrades. Earn 1e20 mana as Apprentice.

collectibles.name: Idle Beginning
collectibles.method: Start with Pixie, then select Zombie at character level 7. Buy sources and upgrades and collect Void Entities until you earn 1e12 mana; manual orb clicks are disabled.

collectibles.name: Void Milking
collectibles.method: Use Voidfiend or Voidterror to generate Void Mana without collecting extra entities. Gather 5e6 Void Mana while collecting no more than nine Void Entities; invest in Insight.
collectibles.note: Before starting, have 1e30 Mysteries and a collection total of 5,000 Void Entities.

collectibles.name: Places Of Power
collectibles.method: Alternate an Incantation or Summoning spell with Ritual Of Power until you earn 1e100 mana. With one slot, cast Gem Resonance, replace it with Ritual Of Power, and alternate. Never cast Ritual immediately after an Evocation or another Ritual.

collectibles.name: Places Of Power II
collectibles.method: Alternate a Summoning spell with Ritual Of Power until you earn 1e110 mana. An Incantation, Evocation, or second Ritual immediately before Ritual Of Power breaks the bonus.

collectibles.name: Upgrademeister
collectibles.method: Buy sources before upgrades, then space upgrade purchases a few seconds apart to keep renewing their ten-second profit boost. Cast cheap spells and earn 1e96 mana.

collectibles.name: Unstable Curse
collectibles.method: Use repeated Magic Missile casts to cycle unwanted spells into useful ones. Keep one pet and level it to 85, collect 1e7 Void Mana, perform 100,000 autoclicks, and earn 1e120 mana. Demonologist XP spells help the pet; summons supply autoclicks.

collectibles.name: Unstable Curse II
collectibles.method: Cycle unwanted spells with Magic Missile until you have pet-XP spells, Void Mana spells and summons. Reach current pet level 95, collect 2.5e7 Void Mana, and perform 100,000 autoclicks. Avoid unnecessary casts once the random pet is useful.

collectibles.name: Unstable Curse III
collectibles.method: Use Magic Missile to cycle spells, then build a useful pet with Unclean Knowledge and pet-XP spells. Reach current pet level 100, collect 3e7 Void Mana, and perform 200,000 autoclicks. Random effects can interrupt active spells, so restore the needed casts.

collectibles.name: Insatiable Hunger
collectibles.method: Build Apprentice XP through orb clicks, Void Entities and spells, then buy sources in bursts to reach character level 90 before Devourer eats them. Keep few spells active so Devourer’s shard consumption does not stall every cast.
collectibles.note: Have 1e69 Mysteries. Devourer must be available.

collectibles.name: Insatiable Hunger II
collectibles.method: Reach Apprentice level 90 while keeping at least 100 Mana Gems at all times. Rebuy sources as Devourer consumes them, and gain XP through orb clicks, Void Entities and spells. Falling below 100 Mana Gems fails the attempt.

collectibles.name: Exam
collectibles.method: Cast many different spells once each to build the permanent x10-per-cast income bonus. Save your strongest Incantations, Primal Power and a powerful Evocation for the final burst to 1e140 mana.

collectibles.name: Unstable Time
collectibles.method: Use cheap Spell Focus casts to cycle into Prodigy and Chronomancer. Cast Ley Overdrive 20 times first, then Time Helix 20 times. After those resets, reach character level 120 and current pet level 100; avoid unnecessary casts when you have a useful class and pet.
collectibles.note: Have 1e110 Mysteries. Chronomancer must be available.

collectibles.name: Hand-made forest
collectibles.method: With Druid and Pixie, invest in Dominance and cast Spell Focus followed by Summon Woodland Creatures. Buy Trees Of Life until you own 130.
collectibles.note: Druid must be available. Pixie must be available. Have 1e13 Mysteries.

collectibles.name: Hand-made forest II
collectibles.method: Use Druid and Pixie with Dominance, Spell Focus and Summon Woodland Creatures. Increase your Trees Of Life from the starting 130 to 180.

collectibles.name: Rule of Nature I
collectibles.method: Use Druid with Pixie and several summoning spells. Put points into Dominance and Empathy and perform 82 critical autoclicks in five seconds, before the 20-minute limit.
collectibles.note: Have 1e54 Mysteries. Have 500 casts of Rules Of Nature.

collectibles.name: Rule of Nature II
collectibles.method: Build character XP through Void Entities, sources and autoclicks until Rules Of Nature is available. Cast Rules Of Nature once within 40 minutes.
collectibles.note: Have 1,000 casts of Rules Of Nature.

collectibles.name: Rule of Nature III
collectibles.method: As Druid, use summons and Pixie to build character levels without exceeding 19 manual clicks. While Rules Of Nature is active, perform 82 critical autoclicks in five seconds; finish within 20 minutes.
collectibles.note: Have 2,000 casts of Rules Of Nature.

collectibles.name: Slavedriver
collectibles.method: Use Fire Ball and Unclean Knowledge to level Daemon, and invest in Wisdom. Reach pet level 66; Mana Sources provide no income in this Challenge.
collectibles.note: Demonologist must be available. Daemon must be available. Have 1e15 Mysteries.

collectibles.name: Infernal Crops
collectibles.method: As Demonologist, build pet XP before casting Reap What You Sow. Consume 2e11 pet XP in one cast; Daemon level 140 or Pit Lord level 115 provides a practical target.
collectibles.note: Demonologist must be available. Have 1e42 Mysteries.

collectibles.name: Infernal Crops II
collectibles.method: Raise Daemon to level 146 or Pit Lord to level 125, then cast Reap What You Sow once. That cast must consume at least 1e12 pet XP.

collectibles.name: Hellish Zoo
collectibles.method: With Demonologist and Simulacrum, alternate an Incantation with an Evocation to multiply pet-XP gain. Use Unclean Knowledge and Fire Ball, with Ritual Of Power and Goblet Of Fire for income, until pet level 666.
collectibles.note: Have 1e125 Mysteries. Simulacrum must be available.

collectibles.name: Hellish Zoo II
collectibles.method: With Demonologist and Daemon, follow an Incantation with an Evocation, or a Summoning spell with an Evocation, to increase pet-XP gain. Use Unclean Knowledge and Fire Ball to reach pet level 666.

collectibles.name: Hellish Zoo III
collectibles.method: With Demonologist and Pit Lord, follow Incantations with Evocation or Summoning casts to raise pet-XP gain. Use Unclean Knowledge and Fire Ball and reach pet level 666.

collectibles.name: Stolen Pet
collectibles.method: As Demonologist with Doppelganger, use Fire Ball and Unclean Knowledge for pet XP. Build Void Mana, then combine Ritual Of Power with Hellstorm for income. Use Reap What You Sow for additional income. Add Goblet Of Fire, with Empower and Hellrage, to the burst. Buy sources and reach character level 130.

collectibles.name: Vision of the Future
collectibles.method: Use Spellhound to build levels, then Zombie for income. Buy sources and upgrades until Ley Overdrive is available, and cast Ley Overdrive once.

collectibles.name: Full-Power Alchemist
collectibles.method: Use Homunculus to create Alchemy Desks until you own 2,500. Chronomancer can speed up the process after that class is available.
collectibles.note: Previously reach character level 90. Homunculus must be available. Have 1e36 Mysteries.

collectibles.name: Full-Power Alchemist II
collectibles.method: Keep Homunculus active and buy only Alchemy Desks until you own 3,500. Use Chronomancer if available to shorten the wait.

collectibles.name: Full-Power Alchemist III
collectibles.method: Keep Homunculus active and buy only Alchemy Desks until you own 4,000. Chronomancer speeds up this process.

collectibles.name: No Rest for the Wicked
collectibles.method: Choose Prodigy with Risen Giant and buy 15,500 Mana Sources. Keep manually clicking the orb so Idle Mode never activates; entering Idle Mode fails the Challenge.
collectibles.note: Risen Giant must be available. Have 1e75 Mysteries.

collectibles.name: Transmutation Effect
collectibles.method: Use Prodigy with Interrogator to fund more sources. The source totals shuffle every minute; keep improving income and buying sources until every type reaches 3,000.

collectibles.name: Transmutation Effect II
collectibles.method: Use Prodigy with Interrogator to buy sources until every type reaches 3,200. The source totals shuffle every 30 seconds and Void Mana resets each time, so refresh Void Mana for each profit burst.

collectibles.name: Transmutation Effect III
collectibles.method: Use Prodigy with Interrogator or Voidfiend to buy sources until every type reaches 3,300. Totals shuffle every ten seconds, clearing Void Mana and active spells; recast your spells after each shuffle.

collectibles.name: Critical Rush
collectibles.method: Choose Chronomancer with Pixie for click income; sources do not generate mana. Use Singularity Beam with Wormhole or Temporal Distortion, collecting entities and buying sources for XP, until character level 116.

collectibles.name: Pest Control
collectibles.method: Use Arcanist and Arcanaworg with Arcane Infusion and fast casts to accelerate bat spawns. Click and catch 100 bats during this Challenge.

collectibles.name: Pest Control II
collectibles.method: Use Arcanist with Spellstaff Of Chamaon, Lightning Bolt, Jas’Aham’s Missile Storm and autoclicking summons to slow the bats. Catch 100 bats.

collectibles.name: Active Necromancer
collectibles.method: Use Necromancer’s summons with Zombie to perform 11,000 autoclicks within 55 minutes. Patience 75 adds an autoclick per second; put remaining points into Wisdom.
collectibles.note: Necromancer must be available. Zombie must be available. Have 1e18 Mysteries.

collectibles.name: Pet Cemetery
collectibles.method: As Necromancer, keep autoclicking summons running so Devourer has charged spell pools to consume. Use Animate Skeletal Minions, Animate Festering Abomination and Summon Unholy Avatar, and reach pet level 100.

collectibles.name: Pet Cemetery II
collectibles.method: As Necromancer, buy Circles of Power and cast summoning spells or Plague Zombie to give Daemon XP. Reach pet level 100; Voracious Plague helps recharge Plague Zombie.

collectibles.name: Pet Cemetery III
collectibles.method: Use Necromancer with Voidfiend, keeping Void Lure and Void Automaton active to collect entities. Continue until Voidfiend reaches level 100.

collectibles.name: Spell-Sources
collectibles.method: Buy Mana Sources and rapidly cast Magic Missile and Lightning Bolt with Spellhound. Each spellcast lowers the 10,000-source objective by two.
collectibles.note: Arcanist must be available. Spellhound must be available. Have 1e21 Mysteries.

collectibles.name: Bad Bargain
collectibles.method: With Arcanist and Devourer, click the orb for character XP and invest in Wisdom. Cast Karnaphen’s Spellshroud 10 times; Conjure Elemental spells are unavailable.
collectibles.note: Arcanist must be available. Devourer must be available. Have 1e30 Mysteries.

collectibles.name: Lean Mean Shard Machine
collectibles.method: As Arcanist, use Spellstaff Of Chamaon with autoclicking summons to collect 1.25e7 spell shards within one hour. Returning after 1e80 Mysteries makes this faster.
collectibles.note: Arcanist must be available. Have 1e39 Mysteries.

collectibles.name: Lean Mean Shard Machine II
collectibles.method: Use Spellstaff Of Chamaon and autoclicking summons as Arcanist. Collect 1.6e7 spell shards within one hour; spend upgrades on shard income and spellcasting.

collectibles.name: Lean Mean Shard Machine III
collectibles.method: Use Arcanist with Spellstaff Of Chamaon and autoclicking summons to collect 1.65e8 spell shards within one hour. Geode can help meet character-level requirements.

collectibles.name: Pest Control III
collectibles.method: As Arcanist, use Spellstaff Of Chamaon, Lightning Bolt, Jas’Aham’s Missile Storm and summons to speed bat spawns and slow their movement. Catch 100 bats.

collectibles.name: Children of the Night
collectibles.method: Keep Nightfall on Arcanist’s bar while using Spellstaff Of Chamaon, summons and fast Evocations to build up. Catch bats for Nightfall charges. While Nightfall is active, cast Evocations such as Lightning Bolt and Magic Missile and buy upgrades until 1e500 mana.

collectibles.name: Truest of Sorceries
collectibles.method: As Prodigy, build enough character levels to cast True Sorcery once within one hour. Returning with 1e80 or more Mysteries makes the setup faster.
collectibles.note: Prodigy must be available. Have 1e27 Mysteries. Previously reach character level 80.

collectibles.name: Truest of Sorceries II
collectibles.method: As Prodigy, level until True Sorcery becomes available and cast it once within 20 minutes. More Mysteries make the early purchases faster.

collectibles.name: Truest of Sorceries III
collectibles.method: As Prodigy, cast True Sorcery once within five minutes. Attempt this after building enough Mysteries to reach the required level quickly.

collectibles.name: Blind Wizard
collectibles.method: Before the screen darkens after two minutes, select a pet and prepare profitable spells. Use B to buy upgrades, buy sources, and collect Void Entities until character level 89 within ten minutes. Void Automaton can collect entities for you.
collectibles.note: Have 1e60 Mysteries. Previously reach character level 105.

collectibles.name: Blind Wizard II
collectibles.method: Select a pet and prepare your spells during the first two visible minutes. Keep buying upgrades with B and clicking the source and Void Entity positions until character level 91 within ten minutes. Void Automaton is disabled.

collectibles.name: Experiment with Anomaly
collectibles.method: As Prodigy, use Voidfiend and collect character XP through sources, spellcasts, clicks and entities. Reach character level 120 while the Challenge supplies x5 time distortion.

collectibles.name: Experiment with Anomaly II
collectibles.method: Use Spellhound with Prodigy and cast expensive, instant spells. Keep Conjure Primal Elemental active for pet XP and reach pet level 130.

collectibles.name: Experiment with Anomaly III
collectibles.method: Use Prodigy with Spellhound, then Arcanaworg for shards. Rapidly cast spells such as Spell Focus until the total spellcast counter reaches 1e6.

collectibles.name: Experiment with Anomaly IV
collectibles.method: Charge Synthetic Entity with Conjure Greater Elemental and Ebonsand Behemoth. Use Primal Power to strengthen its Evocation effect and keep Void Automaton collecting entities. Reach 1e6 Void Entities collected.

collectibles.name: Handmade Copy
collectibles.method: As Prodigy with Doppelganger, cast spells to level the pet and use True Sorcery for character XP. Buy sources, collect entities and use autoclicks until character level 140.

collectibles.name: Children of the Night II
collectibles.method: Keep Nightfall on Prodigy’s bar and charge spells with Spellhound. Catch bats, then cast Nightfall with Spell Focus, Kelphior’s Black Beam and profitable Incantations. Buy upgrades and sources until 1e500 mana.

collectibles.name: Voidmaniac
collectibles.method: As Voidmancer, invest in Wisdom and collect Void Entities for levels. Use Summon Winged Night to help build a current Void Mana balance of 1e6.
collectibles.note: Make Voidmancer available and have 1e33 Mysteries. Collect 1e6 Void Mana before starting.

collectibles.name: These Will Suffice
collectibles.method: Collect 45 Void Entities within one hour while buying at most 24 upgrades. Spend upgrades on profits and two spell slots, then use Void Prison and Summon Winged Night to supply entities.
collectibles.note: Have 1e48 Mysteries. Voidmancer must be available.

collectibles.name: These Will Suffice II
collectibles.method: Cast spells 1,000 times within one hour while buying at most 14 upgrades. Use Spellhound or Interrogator with Voidbolt and Spell Focus; prioritize spell slots, autocasting and shard upgrades.

collectibles.name: These Will Suffice III
collectibles.method: Own 7,600 Mana Sources within one hour with at most nine upgrades. Buy two spell slots, the Nexi profit upgrades for 200%, 300% and 400%, the Rift profit upgrades for 200% and 300%, and Probabilities Manipulation. Use Voidbolt, Spell Focus, then Summon Winged Night and Ebon Truncheon as available.

collectibles.name: Blessed by the Void
collectibles.method: Use Voidmancer with Spellhound or Interrogator. Build sources and use the available persistent spells, then cast Voidbolt and Void Syphon with elemental summons until character level 105.
collectibles.note: Have 1e65 Mysteries. Druid must previously have reached level 80. Necromancer must previously have reached level 80. Arcanist must previously have reached level 80. Prodigy must previously have reached level 80. Voidmancer must previously have reached level 80.

collectibles.name: Places Of Power III
collectibles.method: As Chronomancer, use Generate Paradox for autoclicks and cast Singularity Beam to supply Compressed Time. Cast Temporal Distortion, then Ritual Of Power. Continue that sequence until 1e120 mana; Wormhole is disabled.

collectibles.name: Vision of the Future II
collectibles.method: Use Singularity Beam with Temporal Distortion to raise time distortion above x9. Cast Stabilize The Flow 10 times while above x9; keep Generate Paradox or Conjure Manabeast active for shards.

collectibles.name: Vision of the Future III
collectibles.method: Cast Time Helix 10 times as Chronomancer. After each reset, pair Singularity Beam with Wormhole to regain levels. Add Void Lure and Void Automaton for entities, plus Synthetic Entity when available, before casting Time Helix again.

collectibles.name: Time Acceleration
collectibles.method: Use Pixie with Chronomancer. Build time distortion with Singularity Beam and Temporal Distortion toward x100, then use Wormhole while distortion remains high to accelerate pet XP. Refresh Temporal Distortion when it falls toward x90 and reach pet level 140.

collectibles.name: Exam II
collectibles.method: As Chronomancer, cast different spells once each to build the permanent profit multiplier. Save pet-XP spells, Void Mana spells and your strongest Incantations and Evocation for a final burst to 1e150 mana.

collectibles.name: Time for the Conflux
collectibles.method: Use Chronomancer’s Singularity Beam and Wormhole for levels, adding Synthetic Entity and the available persistent spells. Buy sources and collect entities until character level 125.
collectibles.note: Have 1e105 Mysteries. Druid must previously have reached level 100. Necromancer must previously have reached level 100. Arcanist must previously have reached level 100. Prodigy must previously have reached level 100. Chronomancer must previously have reached level 120.

collectibles.name: Gate to the Past
collectibles.method: As Chronomancer, build XP and upgrades, then cast Wormhole while watching Skipped Time on the portrait tooltip. Stop at 1980 years and cast Time Helix before the counter reaches 1981 years.
collectibles.note: Complete Vision of the Future III.

collectibles.name: Unholy Traveler
collectibles.method: After building character levels, use Singularity Beam, Temporal Distortion and Superposition to spend Compressed Time and level Pit Lord. Buy upgrades and reach pet level 100. Stop casting Wormhole; Wormhole or distortion falling to x1 resets pet XP.

collectibles.name: Places Of Power IV
collectibles.method: As Umbramancer, cast a Shadow spell before each Ritual Of Power. Build character levels and Liquid Shadow first, then continue the alternating casts until 1e130 mana.

collectibles.name: Shadows in Darkness
collectibles.method: During the first two minutes, before the screen darkens, equip Conjure Manabeast with Onyx Hound, plus Day Into Night and Dancing Flame. Add Condensing Shadows and Flash Fire. Use Shadow Stalker or Arcanaworg, buy sources and collect shadow clots until character level 115 within ten minutes.
collectibles.note: Have 1e120 Mysteries. Umbramancer must be available. Previously reach character level 125.

collectibles.name: Balanced Darkness
collectibles.method: Build Liquid Shadow with Day Into Night, Dancing Flame and Conjure Manabeast. Above 20,000 shadow, add Onyx Hound and Condensing Shadows. Wait for roughly 2e7 shadow before adding Umbral Rage to spend 1e7; the amount spent must always stay below your current balance.
collectibles.note: Have 1e130 Mysteries. Umbramancer must be available.

collectibles.name: Exam III
collectibles.method: As Umbramancer, spend each spell’s single allowed cast to build the income multiplier. Use Arcanaworg to fill expensive spells and save useful profit buffs for the final burst to 1e165 mana. Keep Idle Mode off for Umbramancer’s income bonus.

collectibles.name: Shadow of the Pyre
collectibles.method: Use Umbramancer with Spellhound, then Arcanaworg when available. Cast Empower, True Sorcery and Jas’Aham’s Missile Storm, collect Liquid Shadow, and buy sources until character level 135.
collectibles.note: Have 1e140 Mysteries. Druid must previously have reached level 120. Necromancer must previously have reached level 120. Arcanist must previously have reached level 120. Prodigy must previously have reached level 120. Umbramancer must previously have reached level 135.

collectibles.name: Unholy Nomad
collectibles.method: As Umbramancer, cast Shadow spells such as Onyx Hound, Eclipse and Seethe In Shadows to level Pit Lord. Buy upgrades for more XP. Reset the idle timer with ordinary orb clicks, since entering Idle Mode resets pet XP. Reach pet level 100.

collectibles.name: Holy Wrath
collectibles.method: Build Exorcist’s levels while keeping excess Hallowed Clicks at 20 or fewer. Cast Shattering Strike once when available. Watch the excess counter while leveling; exceeding 20 fails the attempt.
collectibles.note: Exorcist must be available. Interrogator must be available. Have 1e63 Mysteries.

collectibles.name: Excommunicated
collectibles.method: Use Exorcist’s access to Void Mana with Spell Focus, Smite, Void Prison and Void Syphon. Buy sources to increase income, then purchase 400 upgrades.
collectibles.note: Exorcist must be available. Have 1e72 Mysteries.

collectibles.name: Excommunicated II
collectibles.method: With Exorcist and Voidterror, perform Hallowed Clicks to grant the pet XP. Use the pet’s Void Mana and buy sources and upgrades until 500 upgrades are purchased.

collectibles.name: Excommunicated III
collectibles.method: Perform Hallowed Clicks as Exorcist to level Voidterror. Combine the available Void spells with Exorcist’s spells, buy sources, and purchase 580 upgrades.

collectibles.name: For the Seventh Star
collectibles.method: Use Exorcist’s spells and the available persistent spells to build character XP. Buy sources, collect entities and perform Hallowed Clicks until character level 115.
collectibles.note: Have 1e85 Mysteries. Druid must previously have reached level 80. Necromancer must previously have reached level 80. Arcanist must previously have reached level 80. Prodigy must previously have reached level 80. Exorcist must previously have reached level 100.

collectibles.name: Taming Hunger
collectibles.method: With Exorcist and Hungerer, alternate buying sources with manual Hallowed Clicks. Source purchases supply shards, so keep Spell Focus and Conjure Manabeast working while rebuilding sources to reach character level 120.
collectibles.note: Have 1e115 Mysteries. Exorcist must be available. Hungerer must be available.

collectibles.name: Unholy Crusader
collectibles.method: As Exorcist, buy upgrades and manually click the orb only when Hallowed Clicks are available. Those clicks give Pit Lord XP; an ordinary orb click breaks Idle Mode and resets the pet. Reach pet level 100.

collectibles.name: Children of the Night III
collectibles.method: As Exorcist, catch bats to charge Nightfall. While Nightfall is active, use Relentlessness, Holy Fervor and Hallowed Writings and manually perform Hallowed Clicks on the orb. Keep buying sources and upgrades until 1e500 mana.

collectibles.name: Wizard Squad
collectibles.method: As Druid, cast Force Of Nature 10 times. As Demonologist, cast Goblet Of Fire 10 times. In Necromancer, cast Dreaded Script Of Harvest 10 times. As Arcanist, cast Karnaphen’s Spellshroud 10 times. In Prodigy, cast Primal Power 10 times. As Voidmancer, cast Ebon Truncheon 10 times. In Exorcist, cast Hallowed Writings four times.

collectibles.name: Wizard Squad II
collectibles.method: As Druid, cast Force Of Nature 10 times. As Demonologist, cast Goblet Of Fire 10 times. In Necromancer, cast Dreaded Script Of Harvest 10 times. As Arcanist, cast Karnaphen’s Spellshroud 10 times. In Prodigy, cast Primal Power 10 times. As Voidmancer, cast Ebon Truncheon 10 times. In Exorcist, cast Hallowed Writings four times. Also reach character level 110 while the classes cycle.

collectibles.name: Wizard Squad III
collectibles.method: As Druid, cast Force Of Nature 10 times. In Demonologist, cast Hellstorm 10 times; in Necromancer, cast Voracious Plague 10 times. As Arcanist, cast Karnaphen’s Spellshroud 10 times. In Prodigy, cast Ley Overdrive 10 times; in Voidmancer, cast Reality Warping 10 times. As Exorcist, cast Spirit Of Valor five times. In Chronomancer, cast Superposition 10 times; in Umbramancer, cast Umbral Rage 10 times. For Umbral Rage, generate shadow with Onyx Hound followed by Day Into Night. Also reach character level 120.
collectibles.note: Chronomancer must be available. Umbramancer must be available.

collectibles.name: Unholy Scientist
collectibles.method: As Alchemist, make the Evocation Elixir with green, green, red, blue, blue, then activate the elixir. Cast Transmute, Void Decompression and Crystallization while buying sources and upgrades to level Pit Lord to 100. Character-level changes reset pet XP, so keep the source purchases moving.

collectibles.name: Secret Recipe
collectibles.method: Test a sequence of spell colors by casting short spells. A sound and a small gray orb beside the cauldron mark a correct next ingredient. After a wrong cast, replay the known correct sequence before testing the next color. Ingredient-selection buttons do not count; the recipe stays the same if you restart.
collectibles.note: Have 1e170 Mysteries. Alchemist must be available.

collectibles.name: Reality Decompression
collectibles.method: As Alchemist, collect a Void Entity to start Void Mana growth. Cast Reality Warping for shards, then use Anima Synteta to level Arcanaworg to 100. After Void Mana resets, collect another entity; if shards run out, click the orb to restart Reality Warping.

collectibles.name: Golden Sword
collectibles.method: Charge Furious Strike in Meditation Stance, then build Incantation stacks with Ritual Of Power in Defense Stance. Collect Void Mana and switch to Berserker Stance. Only cast Furious Strike when its tooltip predicts at least 1e390 mana; any earlier Evocation fails the attempt.
collectibles.note: Have 1e200 Mysteries. Ironsoul must be available.

collectibles.name: Stolen Pet II
collectibles.method: As Abolisher with Anima Construct, cast Conjure Manabeast once and collect entities with Void Lure. Charge Syphon Power, then add Nullzone, Materialise Doppelganger, Fire with Fire and Counterspell. Buy sources and reach character level 135.

collectibles.name: Stolen Pet III
collectibles.method: As Abolisher with Pit Lord, use Void Lure and Conjure Manabeast to build XP, then Syphon Power, Nullzone, Materialise Doppelganger, Fire with Fire and Counterspell. Buy sources and collect entities until character level 140.

collectibles.name: Exam IV
collectibles.method: As Abolisher, spend different spells’ single casts to build the profit multiplier, saving the final buffs. Start Void Prison and Void Lure. With about 30 seconds left on their timers, cast Void Radiance and Ebon Truncheon. When Ebon Truncheon’s 20-second effect ends, activate Hallowed Writings with Nullzone, then Ley Overdrive and Fire with Fire. Cast Counterspell promptly to reach 1e200 mana.

collectibles.name: Army of Two
collectibles.method: Put Ritual Of Power immediately before Counterspell on the spell bar, alongside Materialise Doppelganger, Syphon Power, Nullzone and Fire with Fire. Their alternating casts increase Summoning efficiency. Build 1e150 mana; periodically stop Counterspell so Ritual Of Power can remain active for a profit burst.

collectibles.name: Absorption
collectibles.method: Build character XP with Karnaphen’s Spellshroud, Conjure Manabeast, Void Lure and source purchases. Keep Doppelganger below level 200. Once Silence is available, stop other spells and cast Silence until pet level falls below character level; use Syphon Power for shards when needed.

collectibles.name: The Legion: Apprentice
collectibles.method: Buy only Mana Gems and use Homunculus to create more until you own 900. Start The Legion after completing the other 99 Challenges and earning 1e300 Mysteries.

collectibles.name: The Legion: Druid
collectibles.method: Use Druid’s summoning spells to perform 15,000 autoclicks. You may now buy Grimoires, Spell Fountains, Enchanted Trees, Dimensional Rifts and Nexi.

collectibles.name: The Legion: Demonologist
collectibles.method: Use Unclean Knowledge and Hellstorm to raise a pet to level 180. Buy upgrades again after the class change.

collectibles.name: The Legion: Necromancer
collectibles.method: Use Dreaded Script Of Harvest and profit spells to buy 3,100 Forbidden Tomes. Simulacrum can create the last Tomes if purchases stall.

collectibles.name: The Legion: Arcanist
collectibles.method: Use Lightning Bolt, Magic Missile and Jas’Aham’s Missile Storm to perform 25,000 Evocation casts. From here, limit new source purchases to Spell Fountains, Enchanted Trees, Dimensional Rifts and Nexi.

collectibles.name: The Legion: Prodigy
collectibles.method: Use True Sorcery, collect entities and buy the four permitted source types to reach character level 150. Before starting The Legion, building True Sorcery’s passive character-XP bonus to about 200% makes this easier.

collectibles.name: The Legion: Voidmancer
collectibles.method: Use Void Syphon, Void Prison and Ebon Truncheon to reach a current Void Mana balance of 1e18. Voidfiend or Voidterror can help.

collectibles.name: The Legion: Exorcist
collectibles.method: Build 50,000 excess Hallowed Clicks. Use Holy Fervor, Divine Ally and autoclicking summons to produce Hallowed Clicks; equipment becomes available in this phase.

collectibles.name: The Legion: Chronomancer
collectibles.method: Use Hungerer to consume all old sources, then buy only Spell Fountains, Enchanted Trees, Dimensional Rifts and Nexi. Use Singularity Beam with Wormhole, True Sorcery and collected entities to reach character level 175. Avoid adding Mana Gems or Grimoires before Alchemist.

collectibles.name: The Legion: Umbramancer
collectibles.method: Spend 1,000,000 Liquid Shadow. Use Onyx Hound, Day Into Night and Condensing Shadows to build shadow, then Umbral Rage and Seethe In Shadows to spend it.

collectibles.name: The Legion: Alchemist
collectibles.method: Destroy every Mana Source using Void Decompression, Denaturation, Condensed Energy and Crystallization with Hungerer. Stop buying sources during this phase; extra types take longer to remove.

collectibles.name: The Legion: Ironsoul
collectibles.method: You may buy all source types again. Use Defense Stance and Jas’Aham’s Missile Storm with Ritual Of Power to reach 100,000 accumulated spellcasts.

collectibles.name: The Legion: Abolisher
collectibles.method: Use Syphon Power and Silence with rapid Evocations such as Lightning Bolt and Jas’Aham’s Missile Storm. Collect 1e12 spell shards to finish The Legion.

guide.context: Expedition level is separate from character level. Progress survives Realm changes, but you must reopen Paragon 4 to resume Expeditions.

steps.text: Claim @mechanic{Paragon 4} at 1e30 Mysteries, then open Expeditions.
Select a location and let the automatic encounters resolve. Successful encounters grant Expedition XP.
Restart completed Expeditions or move to another location until Expedition level reaches 100.

achievements.displayName: When The World Ends, Collect Your Things
achievements.description: Move to a new Realm for the first time.
achievements.sortReason: Cumulative elapsed progression; complete optional unlocks as their systems become available.
achievements.summary: Change Realm for the first time.

guide.context: Changing Realm resets Mysteries, Paragon and several other systems. Completed achievements, Challenges and Legacy progress remain.

steps.text: Earn 1e400 Mysteries and claim @mechanic{Paragon 27} in Journal (J).
Open the Realm change screen and confirm the move to a new Realm for Memories.

guide.context: A Realm change resets God levels. Finish level 35 before changing Realm, or reopen the Pantheon and level the God again.

steps.text: Claim @mechanic{Paragon 31} at 1e500 Mysteries to make Animatealia available.
In the Pantheon, assign an Acolyte to @mechanic{Animatealia} to begin gaining God XP.
Use Offerings and Scriptures on Animatealia to increase XP gain. Avoid assigning minor Gods that drain Animatealia while leveling.
Keep the Acolyte assigned to Animatealia until the God reaches level 35.

guide.context: Legacy persists across Realm changes; meeting a later requirement does not skip earlier Legacy tasks.

steps.text: Open Journal (J) and work down the @mechanic{Legacy} tasks in order.
Finish the earlier Legacy tasks, and keep collecting Enchanting Dust over your continuing save.
